More about Vexo
Made with AI Edit
Vexo is a hardware and artificial intelligence company founded in 2026 by Haris Malik, Farqaleet Kiani, and Vikram Narra.
Based in San Francisco, the company is part of Y Combinator's Fall 2026 batch. The founding team brings experience from major technology companies; CEO Haris Malik previously worked at Tesla and K-Scale Labs, CTO Farqaleet Kiani has a background at Tesla, AMD, and GM, and CPO Vikram Narra comes from Amazon and Shopify.
The company is developing an AI-powered personal assistant integrated into a woven bracelet. The device features a microphone and health sensors but intentionally has no screen.
It processes auditory context into private, user-controlled memories and then autonomously initiates actions through the user's existing applications, such as booking a reservation, sending a follow-up email, or ordering items.
The business operates in the personal productivity and wearable technology markets.

Vexo is an always-listening AI bracelet. Throughout the day it captures the conversations around the wearer and turns them into a private, searchable memory: transcripts, people, preferences, projects, commitments, saved notes and reminders.
The Vexo MCP server exposes that memory to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol .
